sourceDocuments.title: Soil Organic Carbon Dynamics Under Conservation Tillage
sourceDocuments.text: Zero-tillage practices combined with crop residue retention increase topsoil cation exchange capacity and microbial biomass carbon in sandy loam soils.

studentDocument.title: Soil Fertility Degradation in Acid Ultisols
studentDocument.text: Acid ultisols in southeastern agricultural landscapes exhibit low effective cation exchange capacity and severe phosphorus fixation, requiring systematic agricultural limestone application and organic manuring.
